description:
Add dependency groups for cloud Spark platforms to pyproject.toml.
Enables users to install platform-specific dependencies with
`uv add benchbox --extra cloud-spark-<provider>`.

**Current State (as of 2026-01-07):**
All 7 cloud Spark platform adapters are COMPLETE and registered:
- AWS: Glue, EMR Serverless, Athena Spark (all use boto3)
- GCP: Dataproc, Dataproc Serverless (use google-cloud-dataproc + storage)
- Azure: Synapse Spark, Fabric Spark (use azure-identity + datalake + requests)
- Snowflake: Snowpark Connect (uses snowflake-snowpark-python)

**Problem:**
The existing `cloud-spark` extra in pyproject.toml only includes Databricks
dependencies and has an outdated "Future: AWS Glue, EMR..." comment.
Provider-specific extras (cloud-spark-aws, cloud-spark-gcp, cloud-spark-azure)
don't exist.

**Scope:**
This TODO is ONLY about pyproject.toml dependency groups, not platform
implementation (which is already complete).
